2. 3. 16. (Currently amended): A method of making a kit of parts as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15, which method comprises bringing a component (I), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15, into association with a component (II), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15, thus rendering the two components suitable for administration in conjunction with each other.
